\newcommand{\CheckDegree}[3]{%
  \renewcommand{\myDegree}{#1}%
  \DegreeRegistrySelect{\myDegree}%
  \ifthenelse{\equal{\myDegree}{#1}\AND\equal{\myUniversityAcronym}{#2}\AND\equal{\myWorkType}{#3}}%
    {\typeout{PASS: #1 / #2 / #3 / \myLanguage}}%
    {\PackageError{degree-identifiers}{Incorrect registry selection for #1}{Check identifier comparisons}}%
}
